label: DAX
headline: DAX Cheat Sheet
description: Quick reference for DAX functions used in Power BI — from aggregations and CALCULATE to time intelligence patterns.

items.name: SUM
items.definition: Adds all numeric values in a column. The baseline aggregation.

items.name: SUMX
items.definition: Iterates every row of a table, evaluates an expression per row, then sums the results.

items.name: AVERAGE
items.definition: Returns the arithmetic mean of all non-blank numeric values in a column.

items.name: AVERAGEX
items.definition: Iterates a table, evaluates an expression per row, then returns the mean.

items.name: MIN / MAX
items.definition: Returns the smallest or largest value in a column. Also works on two scalar arguments.

items.name: MINX / MAXX
items.definition: Iterates a table, evaluates an expression per row, and returns the min or max result.

items.name: COUNT
items.definition: Counts numeric non-blank values in a column. Use COUNTA for text columns.

items.name: COUNTA
items.definition: Counts non-blank values of any data type in a column.

items.name: COUNTROWS
items.definition: Returns the number of rows in a table or table expression. Often used with FILTER.

items.name: COUNTBLANK
items.definition: Counts the number of blank (empty or null) cells in a column.

items.name: DISTINCTCOUNT
items.definition: Counts the number of unique non-blank values in a column.

items.name: COUNTX
items.definition: Iterates a table and counts the rows where the expression is non-blank.

items.name: PRODUCT
items.definition: Multiplies all values in a column together and returns the result.

items.name: PRODUCTX
items.definition: Iterates a table, evaluates an expression per row, then multiplies all results.

items.name: CALCULATE
items.definition: Evaluates an expression after modifying the filter context. The most important DAX function — it is what makes context transitions possible.

items.name: CALCULATETABLE
items.definition: Same as CALCULATE but returns a filtered table instead of a scalar value.

items.name: FILTER
items.definition: Returns a table containing only the rows where the condition is TRUE. Often used inside CALCULATE to pass row-level conditions.

items.name: ALL
items.definition: Removes all filters from the specified table or column. Use inside CALCULATE to ignore slicers.

items.name: ALLEXCEPT
items.definition: Removes all filters from a table except the specified columns. Useful for keeping one dimension active while clearing others.

items.name: ALLSELECTED
items.definition: Removes filters applied inside the current visual but keeps filters from slicers and other visuals — used for percent-of-visual-total patterns.

items.name: REMOVEFILTERS
items.definition: Clearer alias for ALL when used as a CALCULATE modifier. Removes filters from the specified table or column.

items.name: KEEPFILTERS
items.definition: Adds a filter to the context without overriding existing filters on the same column — used inside CALCULATE.

items.name: ALLCROSSFILTERED
items.definition: Removes all filters including those applied via cross-filter relationships.

items.name: CROSSFILTER
items.definition: Controls the cross-filter direction for a relationship within a CALCULATE expression. Direction: BOTH, ONEWAY, or NONE.

items.name: USERELATIONSHIP
items.definition: Activates an inactive relationship within a CALCULATE expression. Essential for role-playing dimension patterns (e.g. multiple date relationships).

items.name: VAR / RETURN
items.definition: Stores intermediate results to avoid repeated calculation and improve readability. Variables are evaluated at the point of declaration, fixing the filter context at that moment.

items.name: Multiple VAR
items.syntax:
VAR base = SUM(Sales[Amount])
VAR target = [TargetMeasure]
VAR pct = DIVIDE(base, target)
RETURN pct
items.definition: Chain multiple VAR declarations before a single RETURN statement. Each VAR can reference variables declared above it.

items.name: IF
items.definition: Evaluates a condition and returns one of two values. The false argument is optional and defaults to BLANK().

items.name: SWITCH
items.syntax:
SWITCH(expression,
  value1, result1,
  value2, result2,
  else_result)
items.definition: Evaluates an expression against a list of values and returns the matching result. Use SWITCH(TRUE(), ...) for range-based conditions.

items.name: SWITCH(TRUE())
items.definition: SWITCH with TRUE() as the expression — evaluates each condition in order and returns the first TRUE match. The cleanest way to replace nested IFs.

items.name: IFERROR
items.definition: Returns the expression result, or a fallback value if the expression raises any error. Avoid overusing — it can hide real bugs.

items.name: COALESCE
items.definition: Returns the first non-blank, non-null value from the list of arguments. Cleaner than nested IFs for null-handling chains.

items.name: BLANK
items.definition: Returns a blank (null) value. DAX treats BLANK as 0 in numeric operations and as empty string in text operations.

items.name: AND / OR
items.definition: Logical AND/OR for exactly two arguments. For multiple conditions, use && and || operators instead.

items.name: && and ||
items.definition: Inline logical operators for multiple conditions. Preferred over AND/OR when chaining more than two conditions.

items.name: NOT
items.definition: Returns the logical opposite of a boolean expression.

items.name: IN operator
items.definition: Tests whether a column value is contained in a literal list. Can also be used with CALCULATE as a filter.

items.name: TOTALYTD
items.definition: Calculates year-to-date for the expression. The third argument sets a non-calendar fiscal year end.

items.name: TOTALQTD
items.definition: Calculates quarter-to-date for the expression based on the current filter context.

items.name: TOTALMTD
items.definition: Calculates month-to-date for the expression based on the current filter context.

items.name: DATESYTD
items.definition: Returns a table of dates from the start of the year to the last date in context. Use inside CALCULATE for custom YTD measures.

items.name: DATESQTD
items.definition: Returns a table of dates from the start of the current quarter to the last date in context.

items.name: DATESMTD
items.definition: Returns a table of dates from the start of the current month to the last date in context.

items.name: SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR
items.definition: Returns dates shifted back exactly one year. Use inside CALCULATE for year-over-year comparisons.

items.name: DATEADD
items.definition: Shifts a set of dates by a specified number of intervals (DAY, MONTH, QUARTER, YEAR). Can go forward or backward.

items.name: PARALLELPERIOD
items.definition: Returns the full parallel period (not a partial shift). Unlike DATEADD, always returns a complete period.

items.name: PREVIOUSMONTH
items.definition: Returns all dates in the month immediately before the current filter context month.

items.name: PREVIOUSQUARTER
items.definition: Returns all dates in the quarter immediately before the current filter context quarter.

items.name: PREVIOUSYEAR
items.definition: Returns all dates in the year immediately before the current filter context year.

items.name: NEXTMONTH
items.definition: Returns all dates in the month immediately after the current filter context month.

items.name: NEXTYEAR
items.definition: Returns all dates in the year immediately after the current filter context year.

items.name: DATESBETWEEN
items.definition: Returns a table of dates within a custom date range. Both boundaries are inclusive.

items.name: STARTOFMONTH
items.definition: Returns the first date of the month in the current filter context.

items.name: ENDOFMONTH
items.definition: Returns the last date of the month in the current filter context.

items.name: ENDOFQUARTER
items.definition: Returns the last date of the quarter in the current filter context.

items.name: STARTOFYEAR
items.definition: Returns the first date of the year in the current filter context.

items.name: ENDOFYEAR
items.definition: Returns the last date of the year in the current filter context.

items.name: TODAY
items.definition: Returns today's date as a date value. Refreshes on each model recalculation.

items.name: NOW
items.definition: Returns the current date and time as a datetime value.

items.name: DATE
items.definition: Constructs a date value from year, month, and day integers.

items.name: YEAR / MONTH / DAY
items.definition: Extracts the year, month number (1–12), or day of month from a date column.

items.name: WEEKDAY
items.definition: Returns the day of the week as a number. Second argument sets the start: 1=Sunday, 2=Monday.

items.name: WEEKNUM
items.definition: Returns the ISO week number for a date. Second argument controls the week start.

items.name: DATEDIFF
items.definition: Returns the number of intervals between two dates. Interval: SECOND, MINUTE, HOUR, DAY, WEEK, MONTH, QUARTER, YEAR.

items.name: EOMONTH
items.definition: Returns the last day of the month, a given number of months before or after a start date.

items.name: EDATE
items.definition: Returns a date shifted by a given number of months from the start date.

items.name: FORMAT (date)
items.definition: Converts a date to a text string using a format mask. Use for axis labels or display columns.

items.name: CALENDAR
items.definition: Returns a single-column table of dates within a range. Used to create a custom date table.

items.name: CALENDARAUTO
items.definition: Generates a date table automatically spanning all dates found in the model. Optional argument sets fiscal year end month.

items.name: CONCATENATE
items.definition: Joins exactly two text strings. For more than two, use the & operator.

items.name: & (operator)
items.definition: Inline text concatenation. Preferred over CONCATENATE for combining multiple strings.

items.name: CONCATENATEX
items.definition: Iterates a table, evaluates an expression per row, and joins the results into a single string with a delimiter.

items.name: LEFT / RIGHT
items.definition: Extracts a given number of characters from the start or end of a string.

items.name: MID
items.definition: Extracts characters from the middle of a string. Position is 1-based.

items.name: LEN
items.definition: Returns the number of characters in a string, including spaces.

items.name: FIND
items.definition: Finds one string within another and returns its position. Case-sensitive. Use SEARCH for case-insensitive.

items.name: SEARCH
items.definition: Same as FIND but case-insensitive and supports wildcards (* and ?).

items.name: SUBSTITUTE
items.definition: Replaces all occurrences of a substring within a string.

items.name: REPLACE
items.definition: Replaces characters at a specific position rather than by matching a substring.

items.name: UPPER / LOWER
items.definition: Converts a string to all uppercase or all lowercase.

items.name: TRIM
items.definition: Removes leading and trailing spaces and reduces internal multiple spaces to one.

items.name: VALUE
items.definition: Converts a text string representing a number into a numeric value.

items.name: FORMAT (text)
items.definition: Formats a numeric or date value as a text string using a format mask. Always returns text — avoid in measures that will be aggregated.

items.name: RELATED
items.definition: Follows a many-to-one relationship from the current row's table to a related table and returns a column value. Used in calculated columns.

items.name: RELATEDTABLE
items.definition: Returns a table of all rows in a related table that are related to the current row. The inverse of RELATED.

items.name: TREATAS
items.definition: Applies the values of a table expression as a filter on specified columns — creates a virtual relationship without a physical model relationship.

items.name: USERELATIONSHIP
items.definition: Activates an inactive relationship for the duration of a CALCULATE expression. Use for role-playing dimensions with multiple date keys.

items.name: CROSSFILTER
items.definition: Changes filter propagation direction within a CALCULATE scope. Use BOTH for bidirectional, ONEWAY for default, NONE to disable.

items.name: SUMMARIZE
items.definition: Groups a table by specified columns and adds aggregated columns. Prefer SUMMARIZECOLUMNS for measures; SUMMARIZE for column-level grouping.

items.name: SUMMARIZECOLUMNS
items.definition: Groups by columns from any table and adds measure results. The recommended way to build summary tables in newer DAX versions.

items.name: ADDCOLUMNS
items.definition: Returns the original table with one or more additional calculated columns appended. Does not aggregate.

items.name: SELECTCOLUMNS
items.definition: Returns a new table with only the specified columns, optionally renamed. Like SELECT in SQL.

items.name: DISTINCT
items.definition: Returns a one-column table of unique values, or a table with duplicate rows removed.

items.name: VALUES
items.definition: Returns a single-column table of unique values including a blank if there are unmatched rows from a relationship. Slightly different from DISTINCT.

items.name: TOPN
items.definition: Returns the top N rows of a table based on an ordering expression. Used inside CALCULATE or ADDCOLUMNS.

items.name: UNION
items.definition: Combines two tables with the same column structure, keeping all rows including duplicates.

items.name: INTERSECT
items.definition: Returns rows from the first table that also exist in the second table.

items.name: EXCEPT
items.definition: Returns rows from the first table that do not exist in the second table.

items.name: ROW
items.definition: Creates a single-row table with named columns. Useful for creating inline scalar context.

items.name: GENERATESERIES
items.definition: Returns a single-column table with a sequence of values from start to end by step. Useful for parameter tables and slicer ranges.

items.name: RANKX
items.definition: Returns the rank of an expression against all values of a column. Tie behaviour: Skip (default) or Dense. Leave value blank to use current row.

items.name: SELECTEDVALUE
items.definition: Returns the single selected value in a column's filter context, or the alternate result if more than one value is selected.

items.name: HASONEVALUE
items.definition: Returns TRUE if exactly one value exists in the filter context for the column. Useful before calling VALUES or SELECTEDVALUE.

items.name: HASONEFILTER
items.definition: Returns TRUE if exactly one direct filter is applied to the column.

items.name: ISFILTERED
items.definition: Returns TRUE if the column has any direct filter applied to it.

items.name: ISCROSSFILTERED
items.definition: Returns TRUE if the column is filtered indirectly via a related table's filter.

items.name: ISINSCOPE
items.definition: Returns TRUE if the column is in the grouping axis of the current visual context. Use to control subtotal/grand total row behaviour.

items.name: FIRSTNONBLANK
items.definition: Returns the first value in the column for which the expression is non-blank, in ascending order.

items.name: LASTNONBLANK
items.definition: Returns the last value in the column for which the expression is non-blank. Used for last-known-balance patterns.

items.name: ISBLANK
items.definition: Returns TRUE if the expression evaluates to BLANK.

items.name: ISNUMBER
items.definition: Returns TRUE if the expression evaluates to a numeric value.

items.name: ISTEXT
items.definition: Returns TRUE if the expression evaluates to a text value.

items.name: ISERROR
items.definition: Returns TRUE if the expression raises any error. Wrap with IFERROR instead when you also want a fallback value.

items.name: DIVIDE
items.definition: Safe division — returns the alternate result (default BLANK) instead of an error when the denominator is zero. Always prefer over the / operator for measures.

items.name: ROUND
items.definition: Rounds a number to the specified number of decimal places. Negative num_digits rounds to the left of the decimal.

items.name: ROUNDUP / ROUNDDOWN
items.definition: Always rounds away from or toward zero, regardless of standard rounding rules.

items.name: INT
items.definition: Rounds a number down to the nearest integer (floor toward negative infinity).

items.name: TRUNC
items.definition: Truncates toward zero without rounding — drops decimal digits. Use instead of INT for positive numbers.

items.name: ABS
items.definition: Returns the absolute (positive) value of a number.

items.name: MOD
items.definition: Returns the remainder after dividing number by divisor.

items.name: POWER
items.definition: Raises a number to the specified power. Equivalent to number ^ power.

items.name: SQRT
items.definition: Returns the positive square root of a number.

items.name: SIGN
items.definition: Returns 1 for positive numbers, -1 for negative, and 0 for zero.

items.name: MEDIAN
items.definition: Returns the middle value (50th percentile) of a numeric column.

items.name: MEDIANX
items.definition: Iterates a table, evaluates an expression per row, and returns the median of the results.

items.name: PERCENTILE.INC
items.definition: Returns the k-th percentile of values in a column, inclusive. 0.9 returns the 90th percentile.

items.name: STDEV.P / STDEV.S
items.definition: Standard deviation of a column. .P for the entire population; .S for a sample.
